system.description:
Range: any distance on the same plane; casting takes 1 round. Target a named creature or place you know (a likeness or personal item suffices for creatures). Will negates. You see and hear the target and up to 30ft around it for 1 hour via an invisible sensor. Material: a polished silver mirror worth 250 gp (not consumed).

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Cleric, Witch
